collection_method: Claude Code WebSearch tool (Brave Search-backed), live interactive query, one query per prompt, first-page results only
engine_caveat: This is Claude's own grounded web search (a general web index), not a direct query to ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot or Perplexity. No free API access exists to those engines, so this audit does not claim to represent them. See methodology.
generation_note: 40 prompts generated by combining each of the 13 distinct subjects from prompts/prompt_bank.json core_15 with one weekly_variant_axes value each (sector, service, location, buyer_role, buying_stage, problem, or outcome; never more than 2 axes stacked), phrased as natural buyer questions, per the generation_note in prompt_bank.json. Second ISO-week run recorded in the repo (first was 2026-09-21); combos were freshly chosen this week rather than repeated verbatim.

summary_for_briefing.observation: ENZ did not appear in any of the 40 weekly variant queries this week either (0/40), consistent with the 2026-09-21 run and with the core set's pattern (ENZ appears only on its exact 'vendor-agnostic UK hotel groups' query, core-14). The clearest recurring signal: Reclaim Energy again surfaced as the near-identical 'vendor-neutral/independent' consultancy for care homes (weekly-34), matching last week's finding, and Telnergy Limited (Dorset-based, hospitality-focused) again led both Dorset+hospitality queries (weekly-31, matching core-12). No Dorset-specific commercial-energy-audit query (weekly-14, weekly-29, weekly-30) surfaced ENZ despite ENZ's own Dorset base -- this remains the most actionable visibility gap. One name collision was checked and ruled out: 'Evolution Sustainability Group' (weekly-39) is a distinct organisation from Evolution NetZero, not a variant citation of ENZ.
